therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: VEGF inhibition combined with DNA crosslinking and microtubule stabilization
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor angiogenesis inhibition and direct cytotoxicity
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: participants with newly diagnosed stage III-IV ovarian, primary peritoneal, and fallopian tube cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: number of participants with treatment success (tolerating at least 4 cycles)

subgroup_findings: Optimal no residual: median PFS 22.4 months (95% CI: 5.4-32.8)
HR 3.75 (95% CI: 1.05-13.34), p=0.04 for suboptimal vs optimal comparison
results.dose_information: Bevacizumab, carboplatin, and weekly paclitaxel given IV
